questions.q: Rainfall in the catchment was below normal for two months, yet the city's water supply has not been cut. Assumptions: I. Rainfall later in the monsoon may be adequate. II. Present lake levels may be adequate for normal supply.
opts: Either I or II is implicit
questions.why: Not cutting supply assumes enough water now and the hope of more later. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2025.

questions.q: Read both statements regarding a cause and effect relationship. Statement I: Most of the steel producing companies in the country have made considerable profit during the last financial year. Statement II: Many Asian countries have been importing huge quantities of steel from India.
opts: Statement I is the cause and statement II is its effect
Statement II is the cause and statement I is its effect
Both statements are effects of some common cause
questions.why: Heavy exports (II) explain the profits (I). GPSC CBRT, Nov 2023.

questions.q: Jonathan passes a church one-fifth of the way to the stadium at 6.05 pm and a farm one-third of the way at 6.15 pm. When does he reach the stadium?
questions.why: 1/3 − 1/5 = 2/15 of the way in 10 min, so the whole trip is 75 min. 4/5 left at 6.05 = 60 min: 7.05 pm. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.

questions.q: The present ages of Sunil and Ajay are in the ratio 2 : 4. After 8 years the ratio will be 5 : 8. What is Ajay's present age?
questions.why: Let the ages be 2k and 4k: (2k + 8)/(4k + 8) = 5/8 gives k = 6, so Ajay is 24. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: What comes next in the series? 3, 7, 15, 27, 43, …
questions.why: The differences go up by 4 each time (4, 8, 12, 16, 20). Next: 63. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Find the wrong number in the series: 34, 41, 55, 76, 104, 136, 181
questions.why: In the correct series the differences increase by 7 each time, so 136 should be 139. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Find the wrong number in the series: 51, 57, 69, 87, 113, 141, 177
questions.why: In the correct series the differences increase by 6 each time, so 113 should be 111. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: If 28 June 2026 was a Sunday, what day of the week was 20 February 2027?
questions.why: 237 days later; 237 mod 7 = 6, so count 6 days on from Sunday. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Find the wrong number in the series: 41, 52, 74, 107, 151, 209, 272
questions.why: In the correct series the differences increase by 11 each time, so 209 should be 206. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Two trains P and Q start at the same time from X and Y towards each other. After meeting, P takes 4 hours to reach Y and Q takes 9 hours to reach X. If P runs at 72 km/h, what is the distance XY?
questions.why: Speeds are in the ratio √9 : √4 = 3 : 2, so Q = 48 km/h. They meet after √(4 × 9) = 6 h; P travels 6 + 4 = 10 h × 72 = 720 km. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2026.
